Sole numeric factor relative to restored swing-sigma-060 stable baseline: touchdown_height_threshold 0.03 to 0.015, with touchdown_speed_clip restored to 3.0. Sigma 0.06, target 0.09m, constant swing target, swing scale 3.0, swing fraction 0.45, touchdown scale/sigma -0.8/0.50, seed, evaluators, and scenarios remain unchanged; 52 tests pass. Sole training PID 1888902 completed normally, and posttrain_range_audit completed all 13 it800-it1999 exports, ONNX/manifest checks, 16-scenario audits, and 60s zero holds. Every checkpoint passed all scenarios and its zero hold, with no fall or termination. Across all movement samples, mean height was 0.0305-0.0341m, p95 0.067-0.078m, and peak 0.091-0.110m. The narrower near-ground window restored stability but did not soften landings or materially lift the mean; classify stable_height_fail and restore touchdown_height_threshold 0.03.

Screening gate allowed ledger_miss fingerprint f62d16285851a7cec2e23ec9f2eb563316a5bc788f1eebe45dc545cee29dd375 at commit 8fcfd3b. Sole numeric factor relative to restored touchdown-speed-sigma-050 stable baseline: swing_feet_height_sigma 0.05 to 0.06. Target remains 0.09m, constant swing target remains enabled, scale 3.0, profile 0.30/0.35, touchdown threshold/sigma 0.03/0.50, seed, evaluators, and scenarios are unchanged; 52 tests pass. Hypothesis: sigma 0.05 is stable but height-short while 0.075 improves late lift but falls at intermediate checkpoints, so 0.06 is the smallest meaningful bracket step to test whether useful height can be gained without the early posture instability. Sole training PID 1856802 completed normally; run 26-11-12_10-05-51-371149 produced all 13 it800-it1999 exports, ONNX/manifest checks, 16-scenario audits, and 60s zero holds. Every checkpoint passed all 16 scenarios and its zero hold, with no fall or termination. Worst roll was 0.161-0.218 and worst pitch 0.108-0.193; the best height checkpoints reached movement mean 0.035-0.038m, p95 0.087-0.094m, and peak 0.113-0.123m. This is a better retained stable height baseline than sigma-050, but it is not deployable because touchdown p95 rose to 0.69-1.91m/s across movement cases and height/softness remain below objective. Next isolate the existing touchdown_speed_clip saturation boundary rather than increasing swing scale, widening sigma again, changing fraction, or strengthening touchdown scale.

Screening gate allowed ledger_miss fingerprint c555472e435f716d2a1d22d6db2ddfac2100f0951b4e7c59ae4484643c031e01. Single numeric factor relative to touchdown-gate-ground-frame: touchdown_speed_sigma 0.35 to 0.50. Sole training PID 1784584 completed normally, and all 13 it800-it1999 exports, ONNX/manifest checks, 16-scenario audits, and 60s zero holds were produced. This is the best height result so far: every checkpoint passed all 16 scenarios and the zero hold; movement mean swing improved to 0.0326-0.0350m, p95 to 0.0744-0.0790m, and peak to 0.1089-0.1399m. It still fails deployment because touchdown p95 remains hard at 1.298-1.386m/s, worst roll remains 0.193-0.241, and the 0.09m lift must be judged from phase/peak statistics rather than the intentionally diluted audit mean. Status is stable_height_fail: retain this semantic-gate recipe as the height baseline, but continue with a soft-landing/posture factor rather than another height-scale sweep.

Screening gate allowed ledger_miss fingerprint e75012ff5b234557b8d50697747549a852238f89ab342dbaa81c33ef11e469c4. Single semantic factor relative to the stable swing-target-constant recipe: the existing touchdown_velocity near-ground gate now converts its world-frame threshold into feet_pos's body-relative sensor frame; no scale, sigma, target, threshold value, evaluator, or scenario changed. Training PID 1770610 completed normally and all 13 export/ONNX/full-audit/zero-hold outputs were produced. Result is FAIL: it800 failed corner_ppn (roll 1.035, min_up_z 0.495) and both posture holds; it900/1000 passed movement scenarios but failed both posture holds and the 60s zero hold (min_up_z 0.482-0.490). it1100-1999 passed all 16 scenarios and zero holds. The gate did increase useful lift on stable checkpoints (movement mean 0.0299-0.0325m, p95 0.0657-0.0719m, peak 0.0877-0.0952m), but it traded early posture robustness for height and worsened touchdown p95 from about 1.0 to 1.13-1.30m/s on stable points, so it is not a deploy candidate.

Complete 13-point 16-scenario and 60s audits: every checkpoint it800-it1999 passed all 16 scenarios and the 60s zero hold, with max roll 0.183-0.200, max pitch 0.099-0.139, and no fall or termination. Movement mean swing was 0.0268-0.0287m, p95 0.0535-0.0577m, and peak 0.0678-0.0727m; touchdown p95 remained 0.921-1.057m/s. This is the best stable mean/p95 retained so far, but peak lift remains below the 0.09m objective and touchdown stays hard, so the constant-target candidate is a stable_height_fail.

Post-training quarantine: all 13 model_800..model_1999 checkpoint SHA256 hashes are byte-identical to swing-plateau-wide-055 run 26-11-12_05-53-52-225218, and task_config.yaml hashes are also identical. Root cause is semantic, not a launch duplicate: _reward_touchdown_velocity compares body-relative feet_pos z (around -0.257m for this Go2 setup) against touchdown_height_threshold, so both 0.03m and 0.06m satisfy current_height < threshold for every relevant sample and leave the reward unchanged. Export/ONNX/manifest checks succeeded for 13 points; audit results are duplicate evidence only. The duplicate audits again show it900/1000/1200 falling under the full-bound 60N push and no useful height improvement.

Complete 13-point 16-scenario and 60s audits: it800-it1400 all failed corner_pnp; it800-it1100 and it1600-it1700 also failed the full-bound 60N push; it1500, it1800, it1900 and it1999 passed every scenario. All 13 zero holds passed. Raising the target from 0.09m to 0.12m did not raise movement mean swing (0.0233-0.0247m) and stable late peaks fell to 0.061-0.064m; near-0.10m early peaks were coupled with roll near 1.0 and falls. Touchdown p95 remained 0.89-1.31m/s. Target amplitude alone therefore aggravates instability rather than overcoming the low-shuffle attractor.
